title: Turned my dog into a pixel art character
author: Chologism
selftext:
I noticed some people using nano banana to turn their pets in game characters, so I had had to try this for myself and it worked way better than I expected.

\> Use a photo that shows some defining characteristics (or multiple even better)  
\> Generate a game character using these references  
\> Iterate when needed (for me this was oneshot, was really happy with the result)  
\> Generate animations (for my dog I did idle, walk and run)  
\> Export spritesheets to use it in any game engine or local project

Let me know what you think!

comments.author: willybel
comments.body:
1. It only let my uplad one reference image. On your video and tutorial you show you can select more than one but the site code didnt allow it.  
2. It generates the asset with an unwanted background. So I need to spend more credits to adjust the prompt to no background? For an asset???

replies.author: Chologism
replies.body:
1. There is a difference between a style reference and a single image reference, the one I use in the video and in the blog allows for 3 images.  
2. That is my bad for not explaining enough and creating a link with default settings  
3. You have a pet snake? I did not test this on every existing animal lol

I've seen some amazing results from others, and I'm sorry it didn't work for you
